name: An agent that couldn't do it makes Boop sad
case: The agent's turn ends without an error, but its last message says it couldn't get the login working and is stuck. Boop is deflated along with it: its mood turns sad, with a sad face, and the finish plays as a failure. It isn't grumpy, since nothing failed on the agent's side.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: a turn isn't routine when the agent's last message is giving up; characters/boop/steering/mood/calm.md: calm leaves for sad when the agent gives up; react.animation: a message saying the agent couldn't finish is a failure; PERSONALITY's Examples: that message is sad, a failure, says nothing, once

steps.message: I couldn't get the login working. The token keeps expiring before the redirect, and I'm stuck without access to the auth server's config.
